name: knowledge-viz
description: 知识体系可视化平台 - 内置大模型生成 KSB-YAML，四视图（思维导图/矩阵/图谱/学习路线）离线桌面应用

scripts.start:dev: node -e "const{spawn}=require('node:child_process'),http=require('node:http'),path=require('node:path');const vite=spawn(process.execPath,[path.join('node_modules','vite','bin','vite.js')],{stdio:'inherit'});let tries=0,launched=false;const launch=()=>{launched=true;const app=spawn(process.execPath,[path.join('scripts','launch.cjs'),'--dev'],{stdio:'inherit'});app.on('exit',(code)=>{vite.kill();process.exit(code||0)})};const ping=()=>{const req=http.get({host:'localhost',port:5173,path:'/',timeout:800},(res)=>{res.resume();req.destroy();launch()});req.on('timeout',()=>req.destroy());req.on('error',()=>{if(launched)return;if(++tries>120){console.error('vite not ready in 60s: http://localhost:5173');vite.kill();process.exit(1)}setTimeout(ping,500)})};ping();"

nsis.artifactName: 知识体系可视化平台-${version}-安装包.exe

portable.artifactName: 知识体系可视化平台-${version}-便携版.exe
